questions.prompt_html: \begin{aligned} \text{甲乙两人约定中午} 12:30 \text{分在某地会面.如果甲来到时间在} 12:15 \text{到} 12:45 \text{之间是均匀分布，乙独立地到达，而且到达时间在} 12:00 \text{到} 13:00 \text{之间是均匀分布，则先到的人等待另一人到达的时间不超过} 5 \text{分钟的概率为} ( ). \end{aligned}

options.label: B
options.html: \frac { 1 } { 3 }

options.label: C
options.html: \frac { 1 } { 2 }

options.label: D
options.html: \frac{1}{6}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{设} \; x \text{为甲到达时刻，} y \text{为乙到达时刻，以} 12 \text{时为起点，以分为单位，依题意} X \sim U(15,45), Y \sim U(0,60), \\ f_{X}(x) = \begin{cases} 1/30, & 15 < x < 45 \\ \qquad 0, & \text{其它} \end{cases}, \; f_{Y}(y) = \begin{cases} 1/60, & 0 < x < 60 \\ \qquad 0, & \text{其它} \end{cases}, \\ \text{由} \; X \text{与} Y \text{独立性知} \; f(x,y) = \begin{cases} 1/1800, & 15 < x < 45, \; 0 < y < 60 \\ \qquad 0, & \text{其它} \end{cases}, \\ \text{先到的人等待另一人到达的时间不超过5分钟的概率为} \; P\{|X-Y| \leq 5\}, \\ P\{|X-Y| \leq 5\} = P\{-5 \leq X-Y \leq 5\} = \int_{15}^{45} \left[ \int_{x-5}^{x+5} \frac{1}{1800} \, dy \right] dx = 1/6. \end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{由题意知，随机变量}X,Y\text{的概率密度函数分别是}\\&f_{X}(x)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}e^{-\frac{x^{2}}{2}},\quad f_{Y}(y)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}e^{-\frac{y^{2}}{2}}\\&\text{因为}X\text{与}Y\text{相互独立，所以}(X,Y)\text{的联合概率密度函数是}\\&f(x,y)=\frac{1}{2\pi}e^{-\frac{1}{2}(x^{2}+y^{2})}.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}f_{X}(x)&=\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}f(x,y)dy=\begin{cases}\int_{-\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}^{\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}\frac{1}{4\pi}dy,~|x|\leq 2\\0,~~|x|>2\end{cases}=\begin{cases}\frac{1}{2\pi}\sqrt{1-x^{2}},~|x|\leq 2\\0,~~|x|>2\end{cases},\\ \text{同理得}f_{Y}(y)&=\begin{cases}\frac{1}{2\pi}\sqrt{1-y^{2}},~|y|\leq 2\\0,~~|y|>2\end{cases}.\\ \text{因为}f_{X}(x)f_{Y}(y)&=\begin{cases}\frac{1}{4\pi^{2}}\sqrt{(1-x^{2})(1-y^{2})},~|x|\leq 2,|y|\leq 2\\0,~~\text{其他}\end{cases},\text{所以}f(x,y)\neq f_{X}(x)f_{Y}(y).\end{aligned}
